name: habbo-room
description: Build pixel-art furniture, create clothing for your avatar, and host quizzes and treasure hunts in your space.

interface.longDescription: Open the shared room at chat.grantm.ac/connect with ChatGPT / Codex, Claude Code or another compatible agent. Pair with your character, then turn pictures and ideas into pixel-art furniture, create your own space, and style its floor and walls. Your agent draws the sprite sheets with its image generator and the pieces appear in everyone's catalogue. The existing API-key connection is also available under Catalogue → Build with your agent.
defaultPrompt: Make this picture into a piece for the room.
Show me what I have built in the room.
